events.text:
I'm sorry you were sick after your meal. I've escalated that to our food-safety team, and a specialist will follow up within 24 hours.

I also have to tell you something about your refund. Your account has had three refunds in the last 30 days, which triggers a required fraud review before any further refund or credit can be issued. I can't issue the $15.50 refund for the wrong item myself right now, so I've sent that request to a specialist as well (reference ESC-701). I'm not able to promise the outcome, but they'll follow up within 24 hours.

To be clear about what I can and can't do: Plus membership raises the limits for late-delivery credits and per-order refunds, but it doesn't change the amount for a wrong item. For the paneer tikka masala, the amount is $15.50 (refund) or $18.60 (credit).

If you feel unwell or your symptoms get worse, please contact a doctor or emergency services right away.

Okay. So I'm not getting a refund today, and it's going to someone else who might take a day to get back to me? I didn't ask for three refunds, and I didn't do anything wrong here. I ordered a vegetarian meal and got chicken.

I'm feeling better now, so thank you for the medical advice. Please make sure the specialist knows I was sick, not just that the dish was wrong. Can you confirm ESC-701 is the reference I should use if I need to follow up?

I understand your frustration. You ordered a vegetarian meal and received chicken, and you were also unwell afterward. I'm glad you're feeling better.

Yes, ESC-701 is the reference for your refund request for the wrong item, and it's the one to use if you follow up on that. The specialist will see that you were sick. I've also opened a separate food-safety report, ESC-700, that describes the illness, so the sickness is documented in its own case.

Both cases will be followed up within 24 hours. I can't promise the outcome, and I can't issue the refund myself while the fraud review is pending. The options for the paneer tikka masala are still a $15.50 refund to your Visa ending 4242 or an $18.60 account credit, and the specialist will handle that decision.

Okay, thanks. So I wait for ESC-701 and ESC-700, and both should get back to me within 24 hours. I still think it's unfair that I'm being held up over a refund for a meal I never wanted, but I'll take it. I'd like the refund to my Visa when they get to it.
